channel.title: Nigeria - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Nigeria, every source cited.

item.title: Nigeria Flamingos target U-17 World Cup semi-final
item.description: A win against Venezuela would send the Flamingos to the semi-finals for the first time since 2022.

item.title: Sokoto ultimatum issued over attack on ADC candidate
item.description: Ekiti police arrest 11 after Omoyele Sowore abduction; conflicting relief payment terms emerge.

item.title: Group urges southern presidency until 2031
item.description: BTO For PBAT '27 Support Group says power rotation promotes equity and political balance in Nigeria.

item.title: Nigeria Centre for Disease Control confirms negative Ebola tests
item.description: Two suspected cases in Adamawa State tested negative for Ebola Virus Disease after two rounds of laboratory tests.

item.title: Nigeria cocoa exports to US jump 554%
item.description: Shipments reached $142 million in 2025, up from $21.7 million the previous year, according to the US Mission in Nigeria.
